content: Kañɗohi

Mi yii kañiɗ ɗu, ɗu ɓi Janguuciŋ Galaat, ñam Pool, Apootari ɓo' woosɗi, yi ɓo' tufkiɗɗi, waaye a Yeesu Kiristaa na Kooh Baabi woos so, Kooh yi hultiɗ ɗe. Mi na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci nik na so jen, ɓoo ɓii kañiɗ ɗu.
Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo, baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam ; Yeesu Kiristaa Heɗi baahohaat ɗu, a on ɗu jam !
Yeesu Kiristaa, a yi eɗoh haf ce wuu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓoo, ne a puliɗ ɓoo ŋ adinaani baahaaɗiinii, te weɗ ini Kooh Baabiŋ ɓoo waaɗ,
Kooh yi yakɗaah po faw ! Amiin !
Yegɗoh Muc yino dong raak
Ŋ feyuuɗ lool ŋ ini ɗu na are eɗ finho Yi ɓeeɗuk ɗu ngaŋ baahohiŋ Kiristaani, po ɗu kee taambɗa "yegɗoh muc" wiiriis.
Keeh-keeh, yegɗoh muc wiiriis raakɗi. Raak ɓooɓi na yahrohe liiɓ ciŋ ɗu, ɓa waaɗ ɓoƴsoh Yegɗohiŋ Muci, wi kaɗ ŋ Kiristaani.
Waaye ali ɓo' nga ɓoo wala malaaka puloh Eel ci sah woo ɗu yegɗoh muc wiiriis, ɗalohiɗ na wi ɓoo woo ɗu ɗah, a alku'aat !
Ɓoo woyeena, te mi yii woyisa : Ɓo' woo ɗu yegɗoh muc ɗalohiɗ na wi ɗu rahas ɗah, a alku'aat !
Andi mi na waake ne ɓooɓi neɓu nga so ? Wala mi na waake ne Kooh neɓu nga so ? Andi mi na waake ini neɓ ɓooɓi ? Ŋ waakeen ini neɓ ɓooɓi poyi ɗah, ŋ heeɗi nike ñaamiŋ Kiristaani.
Findi Pool nikoh Apootar
Ɓaah ciŋ ngo, mi yii inhiɗ ɗu ne Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ yegɗoh, wa liiɓ ɓo' haa,
mi ŋ haf fo ŋ rahsohɗi wa ŋ ɓo' te ɓo' jangiɗɗi so wa, waaye Yeesu Kiristaa a yi teeɓ po wa.
Ɗu kerhiɗ findi ŋ mandee ɗeɓgaan, wa ŋ nik ŋ waasiŋ Yawuut ci : Ŋ meeɗ meeɗ tolfiɗ ɓi Janguuniŋ Kooh tolfiɗ miskiɗ ne ŋ ɗumba.
Ŋ waasiŋ Yawuut ci, ñam saandee ɓo' laayiɗ ŋ gomal ciŋ ngo, ñam uupee ɓa sawar ŋ mbaah ciŋ caac ciŋ ɓoo.
Waaye ŋ baahohiŋ Kooh, a waɗkiɗ to wa ŋ nik ŋ rookaŋ yaay ɓoo, a ɓeeɗukka so ne ŋ pangkiɗ ɗe. Wa wa neɓ ɗe,
a teeɓiɗ to Kuɓkiŋ ɗe ne ŋ woo ɓi nikɗi Yawuut Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗe. Ŋ ineem, ŋ meekisɗi ali ɓo',
ŋ kaɗɗi sah Yerusalem ne ŋ marak ɓi koc co nik Apootar, ŋ jaar kaɗ Arabi, ŋ dokukka Damas.
Wa degga kiis kaahay, ŋ kaɗta Yerusalem ne ŋ inhoh na Piyeer, ŋ nikka ɗiskaŋ ɗe neeh ndaŋkiyaah na yatuus (15).
Waaye ŋ hotɗi ali Apootar wiiriis, ɗal Saak, taambɗoh Heɗi.
Ini ŋ fiisiɗ ɗu weem, Kooh yi tiimb mbo inhiɗ ne ŋ leyɗi.
Ƴutta ŋ kaɗta kur caŋ Siri na Silisi.
Ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ ɓi Janguuciŋ Kiristaani nik ŋ Yudee, ɓa inheeɗi so.
Ɓa kerhee ɓooɓi woyee rek ne : « Ƴaari meeɗ ɓoo tolfiɗ, a na yegɗohe kotii Yegɗohiŋ Muci ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ kosi a jeemee yahroh. »
Ɓa yakiɗta Kooh ŋ ini kaɗ nga so.
